Bootstrap Percentile Interval of a Median

Source: R/analysis-resampling.R
BootstrapMedianInterval.Rd

Resamples the finite values of each group with replacement and reports the percentile interval of the resampled medians (quantile type 7, which is NumPy's default linear percentile). Draws come from R's Mersenne-Twister generator with a declared seed, or from supplied resampling indices (for example indices archived from another implementation), so that the interval can be reproduced exactly.

Usage

BootstrapMedianInterval(
  data,
  value,
  groups = NULL,
  n_boot = 10000L,
  conf_level = 0.95,
  seed = NULL,
  reseed = TRUE,
  indices = NULL,
  index_base = 1L
)

Arguments

data

Data frame in long form.

value

Numeric value column.

groups

Optional group columns; one interval per group.

n_boot

Number of resamples.

conf_level

Interval coverage.

seed

Optional whole-number seed. With reseed = TRUE every group starts from this seed (as a per-call generator would); otherwise groups share one stream in output order. The caller's random stream is restored.

reseed

See seed.

indices

Optional supplied draws: an integer matrix with n_boot rows and one column per finite value (a single group), or a named list of such matrices keyed by hypothesis_id-style group labels (group values joined by " :: "). Each row is one resample.

index_base

1 (R) or 0 (zero-based archived indices).

Value

A data frame with the group columns, n, median, lower, upper, conf_level, n_boot, seed and draws ("R_MERSENNE_TWISTER" or "SUPPLIED").

Examples

d <- data.frame(g = rep(c("a", "b"), each = 8), v = c(1:8, (1:8)^2))
BootstrapMedianInterval(d, "v", "g", n_boot = 2000, seed = 42)
#>   g n median lower upper conf_level n_boot seed              draws
#> 1 a 8    4.5     2   6.5       0.95   2000   42 R_MERSENNE_TWISTER
#> 2 b 8   20.5     4  42.5       0.95   2000   42 R_MERSENNE_TWISTER
